subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split so configured `heartbeat.session` precedence is fixed first while Telegram DM default-to-main behavior remains a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: Current source supports the heartbeat precedence bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from the documented `session.dmScope: main` default would intentionally alter existing user session behavior.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins without changing Telegram DM defaults in the same patch.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default and require the broader docs, migration, and compatibility review in one product decision.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat-entry design
options.body: Keep this bug open until native per-session heartbeat scheduling work settles the longer-term product model.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins without changing Telegram DM defaults in the same patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to the configurable heartbeat-session feature history and is the best available owner for the product-scope split decision.
